title: service-analytics: list_datasets / query_dataset AI tools with the D3 selection rule and provenance (ADR-0149 D2-D4)
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2eAG5J8aqAyPZif4BJ

Filing gate: ② a child card of an Accepted ADR. [ADR-0149](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/docs/adr/0149-ai-answers-business-questions-through-the-dataset-semantic-layer.md) D7 card 2. Parent: #31503, landed by PR #31535.
Reader: the `domain:server` lane (`packages/services/service-analytics`). It starts after the spec card for D1/D2 (filed beside this one) lands.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "list_datasets query_dataset service-analytics" found nothing besides #31503.

## 维护者速读

- **问题：** 让 AI 按数据集指标取数：在 service-analytics 里实现两个工具（列数据集、按数据集查询），一份定义、一个执行器。
- **影响面：** 新增 AI 工具，权限沿用现有数据集查询的同一套检查，不加门也不绕门（ADR D4）。
- **需要您做的：** 无，由 server 车道实现。

## Task

- [ ] **D2:** two `AIToolDefinition`s and the shared executor in service-analytics. Executor input is `queryDataset` with the caller's `callCtx`.
- [ ] Catalogue builder: admits only what the caller may read, and withholds fields per D4.
- [ ] **D3:** term matcher. One hit uses the member, several hits ask the caller to choose, none falls back to the object query labelled 「非指标口径」. Add `provenance` that the model cannot invent.
  - Recommended practice from M2: when the fallback object already has a dataset, add one hint line. This is not a rule.
- [ ] The compiler writes member descriptions onto the Cube.
- [ ] Four-face parity test across REST, chat tool, MCP tool and the direct service call.
- [ ] **D4 caveat (measured):** without the plugin-wired hooks, `assertQueryObjectsExposed` warns once and passes, and `assertReadAdmitted` returns silently. The tools must require the plugin-wired service; pin that with a test.
